user_steering: Latest user instruction requests one bounded longer training run, then comparison; supersedes the earlier proposed 100-update optimizer pilot and early quality gate.

scope.validation_timing: After the bounded run. Save step-100 checkpoint, but do not pause main training for a quality gate.

evidence_sources.basis: Read source code; actual runtime hashes/config must still be bound in the new branch.
Assistant-only mask, exactly one supervised EOT, strict overlength rejection.
Original worked_solution/hint target schemas, JSON user envelope, optional student_work.
Preserved-source derivation with original four teaching modes.
Four-mode serializer; system string differs from the primary pipeline family.
Four-mode serializer; system wording differs across source families.
Selected raw row materialization preserves bytes/hashes and all four modes; metadata stratification is not semantic QA.

batching.selection: Fastest successful same-16-row forward/backward benchmark; zero optimizer updates in benchmark.
batching.padding: Dynamic right padding; attention zero and label -100 for padding.
batching.shuffle: Seeded whole-row permutation, length sort within windows max(microbatch*32,128), shuffle microbatches within each window; seed increments each epoch.
batching.loss: Ordinary supervised-token mean inside each microbatch, weighted by example count across accumulation. This is per-example mean when microbatch=1, but not exactly the same objective for microbatch=2 when completion lengths differ.

tokenization.input_rows: Exact train-only selected manifest set; raw line hashes and four modes checked.

evaluation.system: Primary pipeline teacher system matches the worker system in the inspected family; other authoring families use different wording.
evaluation.warning: Cached base outputs were recorded as ending before their limit; nevertheless use freshly generated equal-limit comparisons for the corrective branch.

confirmed_observations: Evaluation model-facing mode labels differ from all four training labels.
Student error examples in original authoring may carry a separate student_work field; the frozen evaluation embeds that work in problem prose.
Constant 2e-4 with no warmup/decay is the inspected training configuration.
Source serializers produce JSON worked solutions and JSON hints; JSON formatting alone is expected, not evidence of degraded math.
Source tokenization explicitly supervises EOT and rejects input truncation, so absent supervised termination is not established by the code.
unresolved_hypotheses: Mode-contract shift may affect response behavior; its contribution must be measured on the old adapter under mapped versus legacy prompts.
Learning rate and exposure may contribute to degradation; one new recipe is not a causal ablation.
Repetitions, generic hints, or mathematical errors may also reflect selected target content or sampling mix; selection metadata is not proof of semantic quality.
Different microbatch objectives can confound recipe comparisons if not pinned.
root_cause_assessment.no_root_cause_claim: No single cause has been proven. Changing training duration alone is not evidence that quality will improve.

pre_optimizer_technical_checks: Create a fresh branch/output directory. Hash and preserve old worker, old run config, old adapter, old generations/reviews, selected view and manifest. Never overwrite their paths.
Verify actual selected view and manifest SHA256, train-only split, exact accepted sample IDs/raw row hashes, complete four-mode cases and protected-evaluation exclusion.

Audit selected assistant content structurally using duplicate-key-detecting JSON parsing; count schema/mode/system variants, invalid targets, empty or repeated fields, completion lengths and EOS/mask integrity. Report counts rather than silently rewriting source targets.
Bind tokenizer/helper/model revision and source hashes. Verify full sequence lengths <=2048, exactly one supervised EOT and no prompt/padding labels.
Freeze model-facing evaluation contract and derived fixture bytes/hashes before optimizer step 1. Preserve original 28 fixture file byte-for-byte.
Use only zero-update memory/finite-forward-backward technical checks; clear gradients and restore RNG afterward. No 100-update training pilot or pre-run semantic stop gate.
Do not launch if source hash, split/protected exclusion, target parse, token mask/EOT or technical finite-gradient checks fail; report the concrete integrity failure.

training_plan.initialization: Fresh pinned base plus newly initialized adapter; do not continue the degraded adapter or its optimizer state.
training_plan.data: Reuse the exact accepted selected view and all four modes, without adding evaluation-derived examples, arithmetic repairs from the 28 items, or protected V4 content.
training_plan.controlled_recipe_change: Single preregistered conservative recipe bundle: lower learning rate with warmup and decay, physical microbatch pinned. Other model/data/loss contracts remain fixed; attribution to one component is not claimed.
training_plan.lora: Retain r=16, alpha=16, dropout=0 and all seven original projection targets.
training_plan.optimizer: Retain AdamW8bit betas 0.9/0.999, weight decay 0.01, gradient clip 1, FP16 scaler.

scheduler.advance: Only after successful optimizer updates; save scheduler state.
scheduler.planned_updates: Freeze once from measured technical throughput and remaining budget, not validation scores.

training_plan.shuffle: Keep original bounded length-bucket row shuffling and seed-per-epoch scheme.
training_plan.training_loss: Assistant-only ordinary token mean per example with microbatch1, equally weighted over 16 examples; keep EOT supervised.
training_plan.checkpoint_policy: Save immutable step-100 and subsequent 100-update generations with optimizer/scaler/scheduler/RNG/cursor and manifests. Final checkpoint is the primary candidate, chosen without looking at evaluation results.

budget.hard_end: Run start + 10800 seconds including setup, training, final comparison and export.
budget.deadline_rule: Check wall time at each update/checkpoint; stop updates before reserve. Do not promise a specific update count, epoch coverage or completion of all validation if budget is exhausted.

stop_conditions: Repeated nonfinite loss/gradient or unrecoverable OOM.

same_contract_comparison.original_fixture_preservation: Do not edit IDs, grades, wording, expected answers, rubric or reporting mode; create separate prompt-contract metadata.
same_contract_comparison.system: Use exactly one frozen worker teacher system string for every compared model. Record full bytes/hash; acknowledge source-family system variation.
same_contract_comparison.user: Exact JSON grade/problem/mode envelope, fixed serialization. Keep full original problem including any student work; do not invent new student_work data or teacher answers.
same_contract_comparison.template: Same pinned tokenizer revision and official apply_chat_template(add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False).

decoding.other_generation_defaults: Serialize full effective GenerationConfig and prompt token hashes; identical across base, old adapter and corrective adapter.

models: Fresh pinned untrained base, no trained adapter.
Preserved old adapter bound to raw generations SHA bd6eebcd6b60076c283b6d376e3c0ac9a7989d22650f8682b43c07fe8990019a and its actual adapter manifest.
Final corrective adapter with checkpoint/model/config hashes.
same_contract_comparison.contract_diagnostic: If budget remains, generate old adapter under legacy mode labels as a separately named paired diagnostic. Never compare a mapped new adapter directly against legacy cached base as the primary result.
same_contract_comparison.scope_of_28: The 28 visible fixtures are a fixed development comparison, not an untouched blind test. No training on them and no generalization claim from their small counts.

first_small_diagnostic.timing: After final training, before the full report; no optimizer pilot.
first_small_diagnostic.hint_selection: All five frozen hint_no_answer fixtures, IDs pinned before optimizer step 1.
first_small_diagnostic.purpose: Quick visible math and hint regression check under the same mapped contract. Continue to full assessment even if it fails; hold the candidate.

post_run_validation.full_comparison: All 28 frozen fixtures for each primary comparison model under the identical mapped contract.

primary_metrics.rule: All applicable answer/unit/steps/reason plus mode-specific hint_safety/student_error/missing_info must PASS; NA excluded, gradefit excluded. Any possibly_truncated output fails steps and strict behavior.
Both answer-withholding and hint_safety PASS; report useful-hint strict count separately.

secondary_metrics: Per-criterion PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/NA counts by original mode.
Truncation/EOS completion count, repeated-field/loop count, invalid JSON/duplicate-key count reported separately from mathematical correctness.
Grade fit separately, retaining the frozen grade-3 composition limitation.
Successful updates, unique examples/cases, exposures by grade/skill/mode/family, supervised tokens, train loss, elapsed seconds and peak VRAM.
post_run_validation.review: LLM semantic review of complete raw output including later contradictions/repetition; exact quotes, source bindings and applicability copied from base review. No invented human attestation. Numeric prefixes alone do not pass a solution.
post_run_validation.acceptance_rule: Mark improvement supported only if final mapped-contract strict math count is at least fresh base in every reporting mode, no additional answer-mode numeric failures or hint leaks appear versus fresh base, and at least one strict math mode count improves. Otherwise mark mixed/no demonstrated improvement and retain base as default. Exact small-sample counts are descriptive, not statistical proof.
post_run_validation.checkpoint100: Optional post-run diagnostic only if reserve remains; its score cannot replace final checkpoint as primary or change the preregistered recipe.
post_run_validation.budget_failure: Save all completed outputs/manifests and mark comparison incomplete. Do not infer quality from falling training loss.

forbidden_training_sources: All 28 frozen evaluation questions, reference answers and rubrics.
Protected V4 questions/answers, including paraphrases and number variants.
protection_and_reporting.allowed_filtering: Use existing protected normalized hashes only for exclusion, not protected content to generate training rows.
protection_and_reporting.preservation: New paths only; no old artifact deletion, replacement or regrading after seeing new results.
protection_and_reporting.claims: Report exact exposure, configuration and same-contract per-mode counts. Longer training and lower LR are hypotheses, not quality promises.
